from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_close_count = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_close_count += 1

        all_bars_present = (
            data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy)
            and data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl)
            and data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.ibm)
            and data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.bac)
            and data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aig)
        )

        if all_bars_present:
            self.EvaluateStrategies(data)

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value

            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            self.previous_aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

    def EvaluateStrategies(self, data: Slice):
        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if (
            self.spy_lot > 0
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50
            and spy_close < self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if (
            self.aapl_lot > 0
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if (
            self.spy_lot == 0
            and self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
            and spy_close > self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
        ):
            quantity = int(
                (float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40) / float(spy_close)
            )

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if (
            self.aapl_lot == 0
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and self.aapl_close_count >= 4
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000
        ):
            quantity = int(20_000 / float(aapl_close))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.aapl_lot = quantity

        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = data.Bars

        if bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.previous_spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

        if not all(bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not (self.spy_sma_200.IsReady and
                self.spy_sma_50.IsReady and
                self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady):
            return

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]

        current_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        current_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
        current_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

        prior_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        prior_sma_200 = self.previous_spy_sma_200
        prior_sma_50 = self.previous_spy_sma_50

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0:
            crosses_below_50 = (
                prior_spy_close is not None and
                prior_sma_50 is not None and
                prior_spy_close >= prior_sma_50 and
                current_spy_close < current_sma_50
            )
            if crosses_below_50:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0:
            crosses_above_200 = (
                prior_spy_close is not None and
                prior_sma_200 is not None and
                prior_spy_close <= prior_sma_200 and
                current_spy_close > current_sma_200
            )
            if crosses_above_200:
                quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / current_spy_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0:
            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma_200 = current_sma_200
            self.previous_spy_sma_50 = current_sma_50

import math


class IndependentTwoSlotStrategies(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma_200 = SimpleMovingAverage(200)
        self.spy_sma_50 = SimpleMovingAverage(50)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) else None

        prior_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        prior_sma_200_ready = self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
        prior_sma_50_ready = self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
        prior_sma_200 = float(self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value)
        prior_sma_50 = float(self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value)

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_sma_200.Update(self.Time, spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_sma_50.Update(self.Time, spy_bar.Close)
            self.previous_spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi_14.Update(self.Time, aapl_bar.Close)
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

        strategy_a_ready = (
            prior_spy_close is not None
            and prior_sma_200_ready
            and prior_sma_50_ready
            and self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
        )
        strategy_b_ready = self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady

        # Sells before buys.
        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot > 0
            and strategy_a_ready
            and prior_spy_close >= prior_sma_50
            and spy_close < float(self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value)
        ):
            self.MarketOnCloseOrder(
                self.spy,
                -self.strategy_a_lot,
                "Strategy A: sell entire lot"
            )
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot > 0
            and strategy_b_ready
            and float(self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value) > 60
        ):
            self.MarketOnCloseOrder(
                self.aapl,
                -self.strategy_b_lot,
                "Strategy B: sell entire lot"
            )
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and strategy_a_ready
            and prior_spy_close <= prior_sma_200
            and spy_close > float(self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value)
        ):
            shares = int(math.floor(
                0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
            ))

            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOnCloseOrder(
                    self.spy,
                    shares,
                    "Strategy A: invest 40% of portfolio"
                )
                self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and strategy_b_ready
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000
        ):
            shares = int(math.floor(20_000 / aapl_close))

            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOnCloseOrder(
                    self.aapl,
                    shares,
                    "Strategy B: buy $20,000"
                )
                self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
